items.a: No, you send a request with your details and preferences. We check which boats are available and contact you by phone or message to confirm. Nothing is final until we reach you.

items.q: Do I need a licence to rent a boat in Thassos?
items.a: No licence is needed for boats up to 30HP — most of our speedboat fleet qualifies. We provide a 15–20 minute safety briefing at New Port of Limenaria before every departure.

items.q: How much does it cost to rent a boat in Thassos?
items.a: It depends on boat and season. Call +30 698 131 8393 or visit us at New Port of Limenaria. Browse [our fleet](/fleet) or send a [booking request](/booking) — we'll confirm availability and rates by phone or message.

items.q: Is fuel included in the boat rental?
items.a: No. Fuel is charged separately based on usage. We explain typical consumption at briefing so there are no surprises at return.

items.q: Where is New Port of Limenaria and what are your hours?
items.a: Rent A Boat Villy departs from New Port of Limenaria on Thassos' south coast. GPS coordinates and parking details are sent upon booking. Open daily 08:00–20:00, May through October.
No payment is needed online. Just fill in your details and we confirm availability by phone or message. You pay nothing until you arrive at New Port of Limenaria.

items.q: Can I rent a speedboat in Thassos without experience?
items.a: Yes, our 30HP speedboats are ideal for beginners. Every rental includes a safety briefing covering local hazards, anchoring, and VHF basics before you cast off.

rentBoatPillar.lead: Rent A Boat Villy is a family-run hourly boat rental at New Port of Limenaria on Thassos' south coast. You drive the boat yourself after a safety briefing, no guided tours, no large boats. Small open speedboats and day cruisers only, all ≤30HP so no licence is required. Safety briefing is included, and guests stay on board at every stop, swimming only while anchored.

sections.title: How to rent a boat in Thassos
items: Browse our fleet of [speedboats and day cruisers](/fleet), all ≤30HP, no licence needed

Drive yourself to [Tripiti](/map), [Metalia](/map), or any route within the briefing zone
Return to the marina by your booked end time

sections.title: Stay-on-board policy
paragraphs: Rent A Boat Villy is hourly self-drive rental, not a guided excursion and not a disembark-at-beaches service. Guests must remain on the boat at all anchor stops. Swimming and snorkelling only while anchored around your boat.
Pack lunch, snacks and drinks in the on-board cooler. Enjoy meals on deck with harbour and coastline views, this keeps insurance simple and your day focused on the water.

sections.title: Do I need a boating licence in Thassos?
paragraphs: No licence is required for boats up to 30 horsepower under Greek law. Our entire fleet qualifies, open speedboats, ribs and day cruisers only. We never offer large boats or crewed boat rentals on standard hourly rentals.
Bring a valid passport or ID. First-time skippers receive extra briefing time on controls, anchoring and local hazards before casting off from Limenaria.

sections.title: How to request a boat rental in Thassos
paragraphs: Start on [our fleet page](/fleet) to compare capacity and equipment, then send a [booking request](/booking) — or visit New Port of Limenaria and call +30 698 131 8393.
No online payment. We check availability and reply by phone or message. For July and August, request at least 48 hours ahead.
